to: Dashdoc hiring team via the application channel in the HN post
subject: Application — Product/Software Engineer, BeNeLux Expansion — evidence-first delivery
body:
Dear Dashdoc hiring team,

I'm writing about the Product/Software Engineer, BeNeLux Expansion role from the July 2026 HN Who's Hiring thread. Dashdoc is trucking-workflow software (dispatch, CMR, freight documents), and 'BeNeLux Expansion' + LLM integration + Python + React + GCP reads to me as: real customers, cross-border document/regulatory variance, and an org that's decided the incremental LLM piece is worth having in the stack even though errors here have contractual weight. What I can bring: bounded delivery on document/workflow seams — one deterministic slice per feature (accepted input, refused input, JSON receipt) so an LLM-assisted CMR field or a routing suggestion has an audit trail a compliance person can read.

Evidence aligned to the spec (LLM integration, Python, React; GCP needs operator confirmation):
- https://hfo-games.pages.dev/ — 21 live, no-login browser games (React/JS shipping, short feedback loops).
- https://github.com/TTaoGaming/hfo-gen-133 — Python factory + verification + ledger tooling with executable receipts and operator-gated effects.
- I have not claimed GCP experience the public portfolio doesn't establish.

I have intentionally not claimed years, degrees, work authorization, or BeNeLux/EU location eligibility that are not established publicly; those need to be confirmed in the ATS form.

Book a 15-minute call if a bounded LLM-in-freight-docs conversation is useful: {{OPERATOR_BOOKING_LINK}}.

— TTaoGaming
https://github.com/TTaoGaming

resume_alignment.portfolio_evidence: The Gen-133 forge shows evidence-gated agent workflows, held-out checks, append-only receipts, and operator-gated effects.
The public forge includes Python factory, verification, and ledger tooling alongside executable receipts.
21 live, no-login HTML5 games demonstrate shipped browser delivery and short feedback loops.
This requirement needs operator confirmation before submission; the draft does not invent unsupported experience.

operator_checks_before_submission: Confirm the role is still open.
Confirm location, work authorization, compensation, and seniority fit.
Attach the operator-approved resume; no resume file was invented by this run.

personalization_signal.origin: draft.source_evidence + Dashdoc domain knowledge (trucking dispatch/CMR software)
personalization_signal.hook: BeNeLux + LLM in freight-docs framed as cross-border regulatory + audit-trail requirement
